import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch, Polygon
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "stix", "font.size": 12, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "text.color": "#263238", "svg.fonttype": "path", })
blue = "#33658A" teal = "#2A9D8F" terracotta = "#C66B4E" slate = "#657786"
A = np.array([[2.0, -1.0], [-1.0, 2.0]]) q1 = np.array([1.0, 1.0]) / np.sqrt(2.0) q2 = np.array([-1.0, 1.0]) / np.sqrt(2.0) lambda1, lambda2 = 1.0, 3.0 a1, a2 = lambda1**-0.5, lambda2**-0.5
if not ( np.allclose(A @ q1, lambda1 * q1) and np.allclose(A @ q2, lambda2 * q2) and np.all(np.linalg.eigvalsh(A) > 0) ): raise ValueError("The supplied quadratic form and eigensystem are inconsistent.")
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(5.2, 3.8), facecolor="white") ax = fig.add_axes([0.065, 0.075, 0.87, 0.86]) ax.set_aspect("equal") ax.set_xlim(-1.43, 1.43) ax.set_ylim(-1.08, 1.08) ax.axis("off")
theta = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 600) ellipse = ( a1 * np.cos(theta)[:, None] * q1 + a2 * np.sin(theta)[:, None] * q2 ) ax.add_patch(Polygon( ellipse, closed=True, facecolor=blue, alpha=0.065, edgecolor="none", zorder=1, ))
# Dimensionless Cartesian coordinates. for start, end in [ ((-1.16, 0), (1.19, 0)), ((0, -0.98), (0, 0.99)), ]: ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( start, end, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=10, linewidth=1.0, color=slate, alpha=0.70, zorder=2, ))
ax.plot( ellipse[:, 0], ellipse[:, 1], color=blue, linewidth=2.5, zorder=3, )
# Arrow directions are unit eigenvectors; arrow lengths are the # corresponding ellipse semiaxes, lambda_i^(-1/2). for q, a, color in [(q1, a1, terracotta), (q2, a2, teal)]: endpoint = a * q ax.plot( [0, -endpoint[0]], [0, -endpoint[1]], color=color, linewidth=1.35, linestyle=(0, (4, 3)), alpha=0.75, zorder=4, ) ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( (0, 0), endpoint, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=14, linewidth=2.2, color=color, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, zorder=5, ))
# Orthogonality marker in the sector between the positive eigenvectors. r = 0.115 corner = np.array([r * q1, r * (q1 + q2), r * q2]) ax.plot( corner[:, 0], corner[:, 1], color=slate, linewidth=1.0, zorder=6, )
ax.text(1.23, -0.025, r"$x_1$", color=slate, ha="left", va="center", fontsize=14) ax.text(0.055, 0.985, r"$x_2$", color=slate, ha="left", va="center", fontsize=14) ax.annotate( r"$O$", xy=(0, 0), xytext=(-9, -12), textcoords="offset points", ha="right", va="top", fontsize=12, )
ax.annotate( r"$\mathbf{q}_1$", xy=a1 * q1, xytext=(8, 4), textcoords="offset points", color=terracotta, fontsize=15, ha="left", va="bottom", ) ax.annotate( r"$\mathbf{q}_2$", xy=a2 * q2, xytext=(-9, 7), textcoords="offset points", color=teal, fontsize=15, ha="right", va="bottom", )
# Semiaxis labels follow the negative halves of the principal axes. ax.text( -0.49, -0.27, r"$a_1=\lambda_1^{-1/2}$", rotation=45, rotation_mode="anchor", color=terracotta, fontsize=12, ha="center", va="bottom", ) ax.text( 0.20, -0.44, r"$a_2=\lambda_2^{-1/2}$", rotation=-45, rotation_mode="anchor", color=teal, fontsize=12, ha="center", va="top", )
ax.text( -1.32, 0.96, r"$\mathbf{x}^{\top}\mathbf{A}\mathbf{x}=1$", color=blue, fontsize=16, ha="left", va="top", )
